description: A painted scene of a dense crowd of men in suits, overcoats and hats, many with raised hands and small flags, filling the lower half. Behind them stands a stately stone building with a balcony holding a lectern with several microphones. An American flag hangs on one side of the balcony and a white and red banner with a black bear emblem on the other. Rows of windows hold onlookers, and the scene looks mid-20th century.
